patthana21.12:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā saññojano akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.12:3.1: na ganthaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā gantho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.12:5.1: na oghaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā ogho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.12:7.1: na yogaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā yogo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.12:9.1: na nīvaraṇaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nīvaraṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.12:11.1: na parāmāsaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā parāmāse akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.12:12.1: hetuyā tīṇi. na sārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ
